# AnswerCue 2.8.1

This maintenance release updates the default AI models and removes the older GPT 5.5 options from the app's model lists. It includes the workspace improvements from 2.8.0 without changing the live interview shell's appearance.

## New Defaults

- OpenAI: **GPT 6.1 Sol** (`gpt-6.1-sol`).
- Anthropic: **Claude Opus 5.5** (`claude-opus-5-5`).
- Google: Gemini 3.5 Flash, unchanged.
- First-run setup now saves its model choice rather than applying it only to the running app. The choice survives restart and the end of an interview.
- Onboarding, Settings, backend provider defaults, connection checks, and initial text/screenshot fallback models share the same defaults. Existing low-reasoning request settings remain in place.

## Model List Cleanup and Upgrades

- Removed GPT 5.5, GPT 5.5 Thinking, and the "GPT 5.5 Instant" (`chat-latest`) alias from selectable model lists.
- Dynamic OpenAI model discovery excludes retired GPT 5.5 variants, and the Codex CLI preset list no longer includes GPT 5.5.
- Existing saved GPT 5.5 defaults and OpenAI preferences migrate to GPT 6.1 Sol on startup, so removed options do not reappear after upgrading.
- Other valid saved model choices are preserved. In particular, an existing Claude selection is not forcibly replaced with Opus 5.5.
- **Claude Opus 5.5 remains available**; the removal applies only to OpenAI's GPT 5.5 family.
- No interviews, documents, API keys, or chat history are deleted by this migration.

## Installers and Signing

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows Intel/AMD x64 | `AnswerCue-Setup-2.8.1.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `AnswerCue-2.8.1-arm64.dmg` and `AnswerCue-2.8.1-arm64-mac.zip` |
| macOS Intel | `AnswerCue-2.8.1.dmg` and `AnswerCue-2.8.1-mac.zip` |

- Both platform workflows completed successfully from the exact `v2.8.1` source tag.
- Windows app and installer passed Azure Authenticode signature verification before upload.
- Both Mac architectures and disk images passed Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, Gatekeeper, and stapling checks. No unsigned fallback artifacts are included.
- The installers include updater manifests and generated blockmaps for the AnswerCue release channel.

## Verification

- Regression coverage includes fresh provider setup, restart persistence, retired-model migration, preservation of other saved choices, shared defaults, provider routing, and mocked text/screenshot request behavior.
- Local automated suite: **1,043 passed, 41 skipped, 0 failed**.
- TypeScript check, production renderer build, Electron build, and package-input verification passed locally.
- All 10 expected release assets are present. Both updater manifests reference version 2.8.1 and match the uploaded installer/ZIP filenames and sizes; the Mac build also verified ZIP manifest hashes.

## Known Limitations

- Model availability and billing depend on the user's provider account. These defaults do not grant access or include API credits.
- In-app model selection remains temporary unless changed under Settings > AI Providers > Default Model for Chat.
- Windows SmartScreen or organizational security policy may still warn about a new signed installer.
- This release does not include Linux, Windows ARM64, or Windows 32-bit installers.
- Automated provider checks use mocks; they do not replace installed-device testing or live audio/interview checks.

Source: https://github.com/FarzamHejaziK/AnswerCue/compare/v2.8.0...v2.8.1
